description: Na₆MgV₂(S₃O)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.32 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.32 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.69-3.19 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.47 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.31 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.64 Å. Mg is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four S and one O atom. There are two shorter (2.62 Å) and two longer (2.65 Å) Mg-S bond lengths. The Mg-O bond length is 2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three S and one O atom. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and two longer (2.28 Å) V-S bond lengths. The V-O bond length is 1.79 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three S and one O atom. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) V-S bond lengths. The V-O bond length is 1.71 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form distorted SNa₅V octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃V tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃V tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form SNa₅V octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent SNa₅V octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with four SNa₅V octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SNa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-78°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four SNa₅V octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SNa₅V octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-73°.
